William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

[On William Haines]: The Sussex men are noted fools

XXIII
T
HE
 S
USSEX
 men are noted fools,
And weak is their brain pan—
I wonder if H—the painter
Is not a Sussex man.
